title: Columns 73-80 identification text on paragraph lines
shapes: identification text GL000100 / GL002000 in cols 73-80 of every line of two GLPOST paragraphs, including their headers
asserts: Cols 73-80 are outside the program text: the paragraphs, their PERFORM edges and extents are what cols 1-72 say.

citations.doc: Enterprise COBOL for z/OS 6.4 Language Reference (SC27-8713-03)
citations.quote: Reference format consists of the following areas in a 72-character line.

notes: IBM's 6.4 Language Reference defines a 72-character line and does not describe cols 73-80 for source; the compiler ignores them.
